scientific_summary: For a fixed finite interval quantizer in a one-dimensional location family, exact Fisher-information preservation occurs exactly when every translated score knot lies on a quantizer threshold. This gives the exact multi-location threshold budget 1+|K+Theta|, the sharp lossless-location bound |Lambda|<=m-|K|, and characterizes asymmetric Laplace as the unique full-support family attaining the universal m-1 maximum.
limitations: The theorem concerns local Fisher information for one-dimensional full-support location models and deterministic interval quantizers. One-location equality criteria and the centered binary Laplace example are prior art. Pötzelberger--Felsenstein (1993) is closely related and its full theorem text was not completely inspected, leaving a residual originality risk.
